about: Five-year residence for retirees who meet a wealth or income test.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Meet one test: an investment of AED 1,000,000, UAE property worth at least AED 1,000,000, a deposit of at least AED 1,000,000, or a fixed annual income of at least AED 240,000
A deposit held abroad must be moved to a UAE institution within 60 days of the residence permit issue date unless it is invested in the UAE
documents: Bank statement showing AED 1,000,000 held for at least two years (deposit route)
Unit value certificate from DMT and a search certificate showing no seizure (property route)
Bank statement showing annual income of AED 240,000 (income route)
channels: ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
